mapper.update: UPDATE app_auth_session SET app_user_id = #{appUserId}, app_admin_user_id = #{appAdminUserId}, subject_role_name = #{subjectRoleName}, subject_kind = #{subjectKind}, subject_login_name = #{subjectLoginName}, session_token = #{sessionToken}, issued_at = #{issuedAt}, expires_at = #{expiresAt}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE legacy_subject_id = #{legacySubjectId} AND subject_table_name = #{subjectTableName} AND expires_at > NOW() ORDER BY updated_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO app_auth_session ( legacy_token_id, app_user_id, app_admin_user_id, legacy_subject_id, subject_table_name, subject_role_name, subject_kind, subject_login_name, session_token, issued_at, expires_at, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{legacyTokenId}, #{appUserId}, #{appAdminUserId}, #{legacySubjectId}, #{subjectTableName}, #{subjectRoleName}, #{subjectKind}, #{subjectLoginName}, #{sessionToken}, #{issuedAt}, #{expiresAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.select: SELECT id, legacy_subject_id AS userid, subject_login_name AS username, subject_table_name AS tablename, subject_role_name AS role, session_token AS token, expires_at AS expiratedtime, created_at AS addtime FROM app_auth_session WHERE session_token = #{token} AND expires_at > NOW() LIMIT 1
